description: This file implements a checkpoint server client in C, providing functions to connect to a checkpoint server via socket (Unix or TCP), and to send commands to perform checkpointing and restoring processes based on process IDs. It includes socket connection handling, message sending/receiving, and high-level process control functions.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection to the server, either Unix domain socket or TCP socket, based on the server locator string.

methods.name: SendRcvCmd
methods.description: Sends a command to the server and receives a response, handling socket connection, write, and read operations.

methods.name: HibernateProcess
methods.description: Requests the server to checkpoint (hibernate) a process with a given PID within a specified timeout.

methods.name: WakeupProcess
methods.description: Requests the server to restore (wake up) a process with a given PID within a specified timeout.
